summary: An analysis report can close the gap between scattered evidence and explicit follow-up work, but only if claims remain traceable and the report is judged by downstream decisions rather than prose quality.

points.text: Every finding should identify the queried time window, source artifact, stable link or digest, and confidence. Unsupported synthesis should be labeled as a hypothesis, not blended with observed facts.
Markdown serves reviewers while structured JSON enables deduplication, ownership, severity filtering, and longitudinal comparison; the two outputs should share stable finding IDs.
The job needs a declared decision consumer and service level for follow-ups. Reports without owners, disposition states, or expiry dates become another unmaintained telemetry stream.
Prompt, model, query, evaluator, and schema versions are part of the report provenance because a changed synthesis stack can manufacture apparent trend changes.
